The diagram shows a thin converging lens with principal focuses at F1 and F2.
principal axis
F1
F2
A small light source is placed at F1. A beam of light from the source passes through the lens.
Which statement correctly describes the beam of light emerging from the lens?
A
The beam converges to F2.
B
The beam converges to a point to the right of F2.
C
The beam diverges from a point to the left of F1.
D
The beam travels parallel to the principal axis.

options.label: B
options.text: The beam converges to a point to the right of F2.

options.label: C
options.text: The beam diverges from a point to the left of F1.

options.label: D
options.text: The beam travels parallel to the principal axis.
